changelog:
- Direct Native Feature Hubs Connection: Home Page three-dots button now directly opens the full Native Browser Menu Bottom Sheet (showBrowserMenuDialog) giving 1-tap access to General & Search Engines, Shield & Ghost Stealth, Media/PiP, and Daily Essentials.
- Daylight Mode (Light Theme): Added clean Light Theme support accessible directly from General & Search Engines and Wallpapers & Themes on the Home Page.
- Unified Experience: Home Page and browsing view now share the same rich browser engine controls.
